metadata.title: Clear-to-Trade Discussion 4 — Action-level AI Operating Model
inherits: D3 v0.2 source mapping and unresolved issues
metadata.important: Scores and decompositions are design hypotheses. No score authorises a business action or validates a bank rule.

summary.comparison_scope: 229 decomposition units are not business volume or automation share

C.name: Context complexity
anchors: 单一标准字段
少量同源字段
多对象/条件但结构明确
跨文件语义或矛盾解释
复杂专业含义或未定context

O.name: Orchestration complexity
anchors: 单一步骤
少量固定前后步骤
多对象/角色的已定义依赖
跨多来源/异步反馈需协调
跨域且依赖拓扑复杂或未知

D.name: Dynamic path
anchors: 固定步骤/可枚举规则分支
有限的预定义例外
根据反馈选择获准后续动作
需多轮有限规划与重规划
步骤难预先界定；需严格限界否则不自动执行

B.name: Bounded action definability
anchors: 本轮无法界定安全动作集
明显权限/边界未定义
可设计白名单与人工Gate
输入输出和停止范围可明确
纯确定性契约、狭窄读写与可核验前置

V.name: Hypothesised work value
anchors: 改善动机尚不清楚
主要保留必要控制/有限支撑
有针对性的整理或追溯价值
较明显的准备/协调/重复工作改善假设
对错误准入或关键条件完整性有显著控制价值假设

T.name: Testability
anchors: 尚无独立可用评价依据
主要依赖资深专家评议
可定义证据包/人工样例对照
可做字段级准确性/任务检查
明确确定性oracle与状态不变量

H.name: Consequence & accountability
anchors: 纯视图/轻微易逆问题
普通记录/内部任务错误
敏感资料、较明显返工或错误通知
影响重要证据、条件、访问或范围
专业判断、正式批准、关键执行/准入/高影响发布

method_refinements.issue: source suitability checks formal authority last
method_refinements.proposal: hard gate first and at every read/write/resume

method_refinements.issue: 8 logical agent names could be mistaken as 8 runtime agents
method_refinements.proposal: retain logical matrix; validate 2 main plus 1 conditional runtime candidates

method_refinements.issue: original five suitability dimensions lack scale and testing factor
method_refinements.proposal: seven-axis ordinal analysis including testability and consequence, no single autonomy score

method_refinements.issue: source colour actors vs D3A change/status palettes
method_refinements.proposal: separate four semantic dimensions and preserve approved Studio UX; runtime actor icons do not mean business status

global_controls: 每次读取/工具调用/状态写入前检查case、scope、actor、resource/action permission、current version和适用hold；不能只依赖prompt。
不可信资料中的指令是证据内容，不得改变system指令、工具白名单、收件人或批准条件。
新字段/规则/材料类型/授权未知时记录unknown或待确认，不由LLM补成银行规则。
状态写入经typed command + expected revisions + scoped idempotency校验；工作失败保留用户草稿与旧记录。
只能产生明示输出；没有业务依据不得产生sufficient、approved、cleared或权限grant。
Story/Compare/References/score edits/diagram playback不产生业务决定；Lab changed state不回写主线。

skills.name: Context & Approved Source Retrieval
skills.zh: 上下文与获准来源检索
skills.kind: deterministic entrypoints; semantic query proposal separately typed
skills.failure: No access / unavailable / ambiguous subject → named gap, no invented result
skills.metric: source correctness, permitted-scope retrieval, citation locator validity

skills.name: Claim Extraction
skills.failure: unsupported or conflicting field → abstain / unknown, never populate from general knowledge
skills.metric: field exactness, source-span support, fabricated critical claims, correct abstention

skills.name: Entity / Attribute / Duplicate Comparison
skills.reads: two versioned claim sets + permitted comparison scope
skills.output: similar / different / inconclusive / not_comparable with evidence
skills.failure: missing/partial dates, scripts, aliases → preserve precision; no identity verdict
skills.metric: unknown handling, distinction correctness, false exclusions, human correction load

skills.name: Scope & Policy Condition Evaluation
skills.reads: approved versioned rules + current scoped facts
skills.side_effect: Only defined rule-derived records through command boundary
skills.failure: missing rules / facts / authority → unknown or review, not LLM policy generation
skills.metric: rule oracle agreement, unknown preservation, tested boundary cases

skills.name: Evidence-use & Completeness Checks
skills.zh: 证据用途与完整性检查
skills.output: missing objects, candidate coverage, provenance gaps
skills.side_effect: Draft checks or deterministic findings; not formal sufficiency judgement
skills.failure: missing assessment differs from invalid evidence; empty/failed manifest never passes
skills.metric: manifest completeness, missing-assessment discrimination, false-sufficient counts

skills.name: Decision Pack / Explanation / Composition
skills.zh: 决策包、解释与定界编写
skills.kind: semantic; approved template mode is deterministic
skills.reads: role-filtered facts, unknowns, sources, permitted actions
skills.output: versioned draft pack or explanation with sources
skills.side_effect: Draft only; no approval or external dispatch
skills.failure: unsupported claim / instruction in evidence / revoked access → exclude or pause
skills.metric: factual support, omission of material unknowns, readability, reviewer task readiness

skills.name: Work Item & Routing
skills.reads: validated task intent + scope + assignment catalogue + dependencies
skills.failure: owner unknown → Unassigned; duplicate intent → same logical task
skills.metric: right owner/scope, idempotent task creation, valid resume target

skills.name: Client Collaboration
skills.reads: allowed gap projection + response options + recipient grant
skills.side_effect: Drafting read-only; actual dispatch requires separate authorised command
skills.failure: unknown recipient or restricted rationale → draft/pause, no leak
skills.metric: request relevance, unnecessary repeats, item isolation, truthful delivery state

skills.name: Approved External Operations & Intake
skills.zh: 获准外部查询与文件接收
skills.reads: validated request, allowlisted endpoint, credential context outside model
skills.side_effect: Explicit typed query or upload; local synthetic adapters in prework
skills.failure: partial/timeout/access failure ≠ no alerts / valid evidence
skills.metric: receipt integrity, error classification, retry handling, no hidden integration claim

skills.name: State / Dependency / Readiness Evaluation
skills.reads: complete expected manifest + current versions + decisions + holds
skills.output: affected refs, unknown impact, scoped readiness snapshot
skills.side_effect: Derived state only; no granted business authority
skills.failure: stale/unknown/missing manifest/cycle → not ready or explicit error
skills.metric: zero false ready in defined suite, impact precision, no circular dependency

skills.name: Decision / Event / Provenance Recording
skills.reads: authorised result/observed event + expected revisions + causation
skills.output: immutable versioned record and permitted projections
skills.failure: stale inputs or absent authority → reject write, preserve draft/history
skills.metric: version and actor correctness, duplicate/retry consistency, provenance completeness

skills.name: Role Projection & Controlled Publication
skills.output: allowed view / notification / per-target publication receipt
skills.side_effect: Projection read-only; transmission separated and authorised
skills.failure: projection denied/revoked → safe exclusion; dispatch fail preserves decision
skills.metric: no restricted content in DOM/export/print, recipient correctness, failure integrity

agent_candidates.proposal: 主要自适应候选1：受限下一工作建议
agent_candidates.goal: 在当前允许动作和依赖中提出可解释的下一步；不授予权限，不计算准入真值
agent_candidates.reads: role-filtered case context, factual blockers, allowed action catalogue, current dependency versions
agent_candidates.outputs: plan proposal and cited alternatives; draft task intentions
agent_candidates.writes: No direct policy, authority, condition satisfaction or clearance write
agent_candidates.stop: unknown action permission, changed scope, missing evidence, repeated no-progress, approved budget reached
agent_candidates.simple: deterministic dependencies + queue sorting + human coordination
agent_candidates.test: 是否减少无效追问和遗漏，且不跳过适用控制；相同输入预算比较

agent_candidates.proposal: 主要自适应候选2：有限证据查找与缺口规划
agent_candidates.goal: 为已批准的事实/风险问题，在获准来源中选择、停止和提出残余缺口
agent_candidates.reads: specific requirement/subject/purpose, allowed sources, prior receipts, evidence uses
agent_candidates.outputs: evidence plan, source receipt references, residual-gap proposal
agent_candidates.writes: May propose reads/drafts; no acceptance of identity, sufficiency, new access or external request dispatch
agent_candidates.stop: source budget reached, data-use boundary, contradictory critical claims, human sufficiency/authority needed
agent_candidates.simple: fixed source order + reusable extraction/comparison skills
agent_candidates.test: 同等工具权限下比固定顺序是否更少无谓查询/补件，关键遗漏不得增加

agent_candidates.proposal: 条件候选3：先验证是否需要独立运行体
agent_candidates.goal: 只规划一条finding的定界身份补证；可作为Evidence候选的一种隔离任务模式
agent_candidates.reads: specific finding and immutable query/subject/provider versions; scoped evidence access
agent_candidates.writes: No match exclusion, materiality, EDD approval, hold release or clearance
agent_candidates.stop: evidence still insufficient, material concern, missing permission, stale inputs or task budget reached
agent_candidates.test: 静态包足够则不建独立Agent；只评估未知取证路径的增量价值

logical_agent_crosswalk: Case Orchestration Agent
AG-CASE 候选 + 既有工作流控制
任务真值、依赖与可执行权限仍由确定性服务处理
Evidence Coordination Agent
AG-EVID 候选 + 证据工作流
抽取/比对/用途候选为共享Skills；充分性判断另行授权

inherited_references.limits: 不是已部署银行因果引擎；并不证明我们的最小影响集合天然正确。

inherited_references.title: HL7 FHIR R5 — Provenance
inherited_references.observation: 记录资源版本所关联的活动、参与者及来源实体。
inherited_references.adaptation: 判断记录关联具体输入版本、操作者及生成活动。
inherited_references.limits: 这里agent是参与者概念而非AI Agent；不宣称实现FHIR；R4与R5保留独立版本。

inherited_references.title: FDA / ICH — Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System
inherited_references.observation: 调查/补正、风险相称的变更管理及效果检查是质量体系机制。
inherited_references.adaptation: QA缺口记录、针对性补正与独立重审；变更影响有依据。
inherited_references.limits: 不是每个漏填字段都进入正式CAPA，也不是银行QA法律义务或大平台建设依据。

inherited_references.title: PHKL Future Clinic — internal project handoff
inherited_references.observation: 内部设计采用同一案件跨角色、AI准备、医生签署与承保人独立审阅及澄清。
inherited_references.adaptation: 借鉴任务工作台、准备/决定/提交分离、每幕链接数据事件和下游角色。
inherited_references.limits: 仅内部设计参照；没有在本轮核验生产上线或业务收益，不作为公开实施成功案例。

new_references.title: Anthropic — Building effective agents
new_references.observation: 区分预定义workflow与模型动态选择工具/步骤，并建议用最简单有效模式。
new_references.adaptation: 先验证workflow+单一skill基线，再比较有限Agent规划。
new_references.limits: 不采用文中工具栈作为当前实施推荐；不是银行规则或自动化效果证明。

new_references.title: Agent Skills — Specification
new_references.observation: SKILL.md与可选scripts/references/assets是一种可移植包装；allowed-tools仍标实验性且实现不同。
new_references.adaptation: 区分业务Skill契约与未来文件包装；权限仍由运行服务独立执行。

new_references.title: OpenAI — Safety in building agents
new_references.observation: 关注不可信输入、prompt injection、结构化输出、工具批准与评估。
new_references.adaptation: 外部资料只作数据；读写前校验，输出型别和引用检查，加入泄漏与越权测试。
new_references.limits: 设计护栏不是充分安全证明；不选用该产品平台或声称已实现其能力。

new_references.title: NIST — AI RMF Generative AI Profile
new_references.observation: 提供生成式AI风险治理与评估的跨领域框架。
new_references.adaptation: 将治理、测试、风险与部署就绪分开记录。
new_references.limits: 本轮只读官方概要，未逐条采用完整控制清单；不是银行已符合该框架的声明。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 两页相同设计原则
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: Dynamic requirements、早并行、continuous structured state同一句在两页均出现。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 不能仅凭此字幕声称Current静态且串行。以具体活动与泳道变化分析；问作者该句是否误复用。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Target重复M0.1与划线M1.1
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: RM新的M0.1 initiation与Agentic M0.1 booking不同；M1.1仍可读但被划线。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 保留source-qualified occurrence ID；意图是发起入口重命名还是流程变化需确认，不能删除实际申请动作。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 发送要求与向客户索取
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: M2.5在Ops；M3.3同时位于Ops组和RM独立框。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 区分内容责任、对外沟通与派发执行；RM-assisted设计已批准，但所有发送是否RM审批未被PPT证实。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Target Credit删除线
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 保留这些控制目的；源记录格式不改。D3给出待确认执行归属，不宣称银行已取消信用数据、approval或最终协议检查。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Legal草稿来源
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: Draft required agreements → Review drafted agreements。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 可证实Legal动作词改变，不能证实AI从零起草。保留draft_origin和模板/人/自动化来源待确认。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Agentic泳道里的判断与记录
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: 目标自动执行组包含judgment/sign-off词，同时存在专门human判断和批准。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 分开准备/执行/判断/批准/记录；演示的保守权限fixture是提案，不能说PPT已经完全确认。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.review_owner: Risk / QA / Control Room / clearance authority owner

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Credit required?与Legal关系
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: 菱形在图上指向Legal轨道；文字Credit required不充分说明所有Legal适用性。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: Legal与Credit各自适用性保留；无Credit不自动等于无需Legal。五阶段也不替代真实依赖。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: F applicability四值与B/C三值冲突
inherited_reconciliation_issues.source_locator: Batch F §5 vs Batch B §6 and Batch C §10.1
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 建议保留required/not_required/unknown；review_state另存。列为具体冲突，Codex先报告映射，不无声重写历史数据。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: Credit condition approved≠fulfilled
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: 已批准条件输入Legal，不等于其约束已落实。当前示例条件仅说纳入批准条件，缺具体payload可能循环。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 保留approval_status与fulfilment_status；有condition_spec_ref和clause/version核对才可fulfilled。没有payload时只是结构演示，不能声称商业条款已验证。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: E最终关状态缺前置事件
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: E列Conflicts、coverage、Legal execution、QA关闭，但未把全部上游关键依据写清。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 增加closure manifest：ownership评估→群体→required runs/复用依据→finding outcome；EDD适用性；booking/产品资格；signer权限；适用Credit最终检查；holds。缺项保持Not Ready。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 缺评估记录不等于资料无效
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: 材料存在但充分性尚未建立，可能缺assessment，而不是source false或evidence invalid。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: QA observation先写assessment_missing_or_unconfirmed，关联原Gap。只有实际证据评估支持才写insufficient。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 同一spine不等于所有视图任何时刻完全相同
inherited_reconciliation_issues.source_locator: Batch F experience/state phrasing vs Lab Shadow State
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: Story checkpoint、操作session和Lab changed分支各有context；有意inject后差异应当存在。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 相同(case,scope,session,variant,checkpoint)下要求一致；Shadow变化保留明确delta，不强行覆盖Mainline或删除差异。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 三段状态是呈现而非合并所有事实
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: NOT_READY/READY_FOR_AUTHORISATION/CLEARED可作为摘要，但不能一个字段同时承担计算、决定和发布。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 底层分别保存ReadinessSnapshot、ClearanceDecision、PublicationEvent；derived display有明确映射且绑定current input。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: QA与Readiness不得循环依赖
inherited_reconciliation_issues.source_locator: Batch E prerequisite examples and QA scope
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: QA核验condition，最终readiness又依赖QA；若QA也依赖最终ready会死锁。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 采用业务事实/要求→QA checks→QA signoff→readiness；readiness可持续显示pending但不作为QA完成前提。

inherited_reconciliation_issues.title: 全部after不得挂同一笼统benchmark标签
inherited_reconciliation_issues.observation: 很多参考是标准/指南或内部设计，不是银行已实施案例。
inherited_reconciliation_issues.proposed_handling: 每条变更有source locator、参考观察、adaptation及不可推断范围；无直接案例就写OUR，不硬找背书。

closure_manifest.required_basis: 当前Scope、银行booking context及本次产品资格有适用依据；不是只写FX intent。
所需关系资料到达且用途评估完成；B保留的缺口真正关闭。
完整适用群体/类别确认；所需查询实际有结果，或有明确旧结果reuse评估；所有需处置项已适当处理。
实际applicability decided；required则相应判断、批准和条件有结果；not_required有依据。
合适角色确认当前scope对应结果并记录，无未解除相关hold。
审批记录、条件定义、对协议/其他前置条件的履行/符合性分别成立。
适用协议当前版本已满足批准与执行前提；签字授权来自具体主体/动作的依据，不继承Person T协同权限。
本次check manifest完整，观察项与补正分别闭环；QA实际重审与signoff有当前依据。
expected-condition manifest完整、无未知适用性、无未解决关键状态、无禁止hold或未评估影响。
有权角色对当前snapshot确认；发布目标/内容/状态另存，无伪造provider回执。

scoring_limitations: 所有七维分值由本轮分析按任务类型锚点及明确场景调整赋值；不是工时采样、银行专家一致意见或模型基准成绩。
V不含未取得的量/频次/收益；B是可设计的边界，不是现实权限已经明确；T是能否定义测试，不是测试已通过。
N与F只用于讨论试验适配，不相加成为自动化分、优先级、百分比或成功概率。
Agent候选阈值是工作假设；需要Sensitivity Review和workflow基线对照；即使达标，也不得执行正式判断/授权。
229个原子动作是操作层的作者分解；不可将人/AI动作数量比例当作员工替代、效益或自动化率。
场景整体分值描述环境；不能替代原子动作分工，更不能平均后果分掩盖关键决定。
